source: Per-file seconds seeded from main CI run 35388990584 (push 8a0cf865, 13 test jobs). Measured files use the pytest --durations=25 'slowest 25 durations' sums from each shard's log; unmeasured files use each shard's residual (2x wall minus measured) spread evenly over its unmeasured files. The per-file 'shard' fields are the output of the deterministic 13-bin LPT pack over these durations.
